sources.note: Nothing on phonology. Stub: 'documented in Shintani (2018)'; cites Ethnologue 18/21 and lists Barkman 2014 (A descriptive grammar of Jejara (Para Naga), Payap MA thesis) under Sources - a different language [pzn].

sources.citation: Ethnologue, 19th ed. (2016), Myanmar country listing, entry 'Kokak [nxk]', archived 2016-10-10 (Lewis, Simons & Fennig eds.)
sources.note: Nothing on phonology or stress. 'Kokak [nxk] Sagaing region: south Layshi township; 10 villages. 2,000 (2004 SIL). Status: 6a (Vigorous). Alternate Names: Koki, Konke, Naga, Koki. Dialects: Very little (if any) dialect variation within Kokak.. Classification: Sino-Tibetan, Tibeto-Burman, Sal, Kuki-Chin-Naga, Unclassified. Comments: Tribally, the Kokak are included as part of Tangkhul Naga [ntx], but their language is very distinct.'

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2011. Change Request 2011-032: create [nxk] Naga, Koki (adopted 2012-02-03). Dallas: SIL International. 5 pp.
sources.note: Nothing on phonology or stress. Administrative form: Koki villages report their language differs from Somra Tangkhul and is somewhat similar to Para; 2004 SIL/Myanmar 436-item wordlists in Koki and Namiyupi villages show 98% internal similarity, 30% with Somra Tangkhul, 19% with Akyaung Ari, 20-24% with Para. Cites Saul 2005 and Tin Yi 2004; says the 2004 survey report's publication was delayed for local sensitivities.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2011. Request for New Language Code Element: nxk Naga, Koki (alternate name Konke). 3 pp.
sources.note: Nothing on stress. ~10 villages, ~2,000 speakers, southern Layshi Township; classified 'Sino-Tibetan, Tibeto-Burman, Kuki-Chin-Naga, Unclassified'; 'not closely related linguistically to any of its neighbors'; no written literature; no published sources listed.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid record koka1245 'Kokak Naga' (JSON) and Glottolog reference searches for 'Kokak' / 'Shintani Koki'
sources.note: Nothing. bookkeeping=true, classification Bookkeeping > Pending Report Release (pend1244), no coordinates; the only reference is the ISO RA 2011 change request (Glottolog's fullest description is only a wordlist). Reference searches return zero hits, i.e. Glottolog has not catalogued Shintani 2018.
Nothing. Reference name Koki Naga; active individual living language; created by CR 2011-032, adopted 2012-02-03; no retirement or merge.

sources.note: The only first-hand linguistic description of Koki/Kokak; LSTCA survey volumes open with a phonological sketch (consonants, vowels, tones, syllable) before the classified vocabulary, so this is where any statement on tone vs. stress would be. ILCAA portal: print available, no electronic version; CiNii shows 7 Japanese library holdings (TUFS, Kyoto CSEAS, Osaka, Kyushu, Gakushuin, ICU). Order from ILCAA (biblio.aa-ken.jp contact form) or ILL.
